 The ratio of the total number of students scoring marks less than 50% to that of scoring marks exactly 50% is
solution:
**Solution:**

Total students = 600 + 400 + 375 + 350 + 300 = 2025

Number of students scoring marks less than 50% = 270 + 120 + 300 + 220 + 200 = 1110

55% of 600 = 330

40% of 400 = 160

20% of 375= 75

10% of 350 = 35

25% of 300 = 75

Numbers of students scoring marks more than 50% = 330 + 160 + 75 + 35 + 75 = 675

Students scoring exactly 50% = 2025 - 1110 - 675 = 240

The ratio of the total number of students scoring marks less than 50% to that of scoring marks exactly 50% = 1110 : 240 = 111 : 24

**Hence, the correct option is 2.**
